meta.title: Proof Board
meta.description: A visual review wall for the deliverables in your workspace. Decks, documents, sheets, images, pages and PDFs from the current workspace line up as cards — Office files show their first page, pages and PDFs render live, images show as themselves. Mark each item good / fix / TBD, write one line of notes, then hand the whole set back to the agent as a checkout list.
